status: proposal-only; no activation or source changes
scope: Managed per-worker invocations in the existing fixed pool, not a scheduler/orchestrator/Actions/hooks installer
prerequisites: Resolve launcher binding and durable malformed-input handling findings.
Define verified normal-merge receipt to task-retirement transition; do not fabricate an integrate receipt.
Preserve exact source/target/custody/review evidence and mandatory platform/security disposition.

triggers.event: Morgan assigns existing idle permanent worker
triggers.guards: Fresh locked target fetch, existing owner/path/common-dir/origin, clean preserved custody, exact reviewed/provisional line evidence appropriate to task kind, no active receipt history, unique task ID. Release/hotfix requires certified baseline/tag; feature/bugfix routine line is release-uncertified.
Actual completed start receipt, same owner/branch/base lineage, exact immutable task commit and checks reference. Output is ready-for-review only.

triggers.event: Independent review/Morgan exact verdict and live PR facts available
triggers.guards: Exact live PR head/fresh develop base, distinct exact independent review, Morgan verdict, explicit required/advisory inventories. Accepted client-enforcement authority permits origin-unavailable mode but does not substitute for platform/security confirmation or zero unresolved findings.

triggers.event: Head/base advances or findings/security state changes
triggers.invocation: block existing delivery; owner correction/review refresh by refs
triggers.guards: Invalidate old head/base verdict/confirmations. Pending advisory is disclosed; known findings block. Actual mandatory alert disposition is retained separately. Never infer approval from a merged PR/empty API list.
Actual allowed preflight precedes merge; exact PR/head/base, provider evidence, ordered two parents, reviewed tree, canonical develop ancestry. Receipt integrates only; no release certification.

triggers.invocation: retire then fresh start, only after receipt-compatibility correction or explicit supported manual gate
triggers.guards: Bind normal merge evidence to current start/ready/task/source and target, fresh qualified required lines, Morgan retirement, preserved ignored/dependency/PR custody, other-worktree refusal and branch-d deletion only. Do not free active history just because merge succeeded.

negativeRequirements: No real trigger execution, new coordinator, worker/session/worktree, hook bypass/install, server protection change, GitHub action, push/PR/merge or publication proposed as performed.
No auto-dismissal of scanner feedback or approval-state rewriting.
Proposal does not grant source/qualification authority or alter standing normal Gitflow authority.
